title: potentilla × collina subsp. alpicola
intro: Potentilla × collina subsp. alpicola, commonly known as Silver-leaved Cinquefoil, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Silver-leaved Cinquefoil are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. Studies have also identified its potential in treating various health conditions, making it a subject of interest in the field of phytomedicine.
